name: What is the difference between an estimate and a fixed-price contract for a home addition project?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between an estimate and a fixed-price contract for a home addition project?

acceptedAnswer.text: An estimate provides a projected cost for a home addition project based on the current understanding of the scope, materials, and labor. It is a good faith approximation that can fluctuate if project details change. A fixed-price contract, conversely, locks in the total cost for a clearly defined scope of work. AKN Design Group primarily operates with fixed-price contracts for our complex renovations once the design and material selections are finalized. This ensures cost certainty for our clients, allowing for better financial planning and a seamless, managed process from design to completion without unexpected budget shifts.
acceptedAnswer.description: An estimate is a projected cost, while a fixed-price contract locks in the total cost for a defined scope, offering cost certainty for home addition projects.
